title: SICA:置信下界选择(移植)
note: 移植的是 SICA 的选择规则,不是它的编辑:在最佳置信下界之上取最新的那次迭代,而不是追最高的一次均值。它读的是本平台的曲线点,所以可以和其他方法同轴比较。

deviations.what: The loop around the rule is the platform's, not SICA's.
deviations.why: SICA runs a full improvement step per iteration; here the rule decides only whether this round is worth spending on and which prior round is the fairest comparison.

deviations.what: The port stops where SICA would spend.
deviations.why: When nothing clears the bound it reports `changed: false` rather than spending a model call to stand still.
